title: Deterministic redaction pattern can equal the secret
claim: The fixed alphanumeric redaction pattern can serialize the exact password/source value, such as abc, in both model.Source.Pattern and evidence part Pattern.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/sink-redaction-source && env -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_ENABLED -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_NAME_PATTERN -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_VALUE_PATTERN -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_KEYS_REGEXP -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_VALUES_REGEXP GOFLAGS=-p=4 GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test ./internal/taint/redaction -run TestReview -count=1 -timeout 15m

title: Sensitive source names are serialized unchanged
claim: A source classified sensitive because of its name retains that entire unredacted name in the serialized model.Source.Name field.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/sink-redaction-source && env -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_ENABLED -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_NAME_PATTERN -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_VALUE_PATTERN -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_KEYS_REGEXP -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_VALUES_REGEXP GOFLAGS=-p=4 GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test ./internal/taint/redaction -run TestReview -count=1 -timeout 15m

title: SQL comments bypass vulnerability-specific redaction
claim: A tainted secret in a SQL line or block comment is not marked sensitive by AnalyzeSQL and is serialized raw when it does not match the default source patterns.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/sink-redaction-source && env -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_ENABLED -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_NAME_PATTERN -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_VALUE_PATTERN -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_KEYS_REGEXP -u DD_IAST_REDACTION_VALUES_REGEXP GOFLAGS=-p=4 GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test ./internal/taint/redaction -run TestReview -count=1 -timeout 15m
